title: Etale representatives of pro-etale derived Isom sections
statement: For arbitrary derived module sheaves on an etale scheme, a pro-etale derived Isom presheaf section carried by an etale neighbourhood of every geometric point has an actual etale derived-isomorphism representative on such a neighbourhood.

source.place: Tags 09BV and 00WJ; local representatives of Isom presheaf sections.

proof.text: Apply the local-cover representative theorem to the supplied pro-etale section over an etale object V. The existing geometric-point lifting theorem for an etale cover lifts the chosen separably closed geometric point to one cover member. Compose the lifted point with V to obtain the required pointed etale object and use the local isomorphism on that member.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etale_local_representative_of_proetale_local_iso_sections
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.ProEt)
    {B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing B]
    (A D : DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf U.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)))
    (hsections : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
      (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U.left),
      ∃ (V : U.left.Etale) (v : (pointSmallEtale x).fiber.obj V),
        Nonempty ((derivedLocalIsoPresheaf (ProEt.topology U.left) B
          ((derivedComparison U.left B).obj A)
          ((derivedComparison U.left B).obj D)).obj
            (op ((toProEt U.left).obj V)))) :
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
      (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U.left),
      ∃ (V : U.left.Etale) (v : (pointSmallEtale x).fiber.obj V),
        Nonempty ((localIsomorphismRestriction U.left B V).obj A ≅
          (localIsomorphismRestriction U.left B V).obj D)
